label: ADS1013 Battery Voltage Demo
info: An Inject node fires every second, triggering the periph-ads1013 node to run a single-shot conversion at 128 SPS. The cell voltage is wired through a 2:1 resistor divider to AIN0 (AIN1 to GND); a Function node multiplies the divider voltage by 2 to obtain the battery voltage and the Debug sidebar shows it in volts.

name: scale divider to battery voltage
